subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land the focused fresh-session accepted-disconnect fix now, or should accepted-disconnect recovery wait for the reattach-first behavior tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The patch fixes the same-session transcript collision, but it intentionally preserves the existing timeout-style behavior where a detached gateway run and local fallback can both execute.

options.title: Land focused fix first
options.body: Merge this PR after rebase/validation, accepting the fresh fallback session as the narrow bug fix while keeping reattach-first as a separate product decision.

options.title: Require reattach-first now
options.body: Ask the contributor to extend this PR into the `agent.wait`/reattach-first design before merge, reducing duplicate execution at the cost of broader behavior change.

options.title: Pause for product review
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide the accepted-disconnect recovery policy across interactive and `--deliver` modes.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix first
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after rebase/validation, accepting the fresh fallback session as the narrow bug fix while keeping reattach-first as a separate product decision.
